basics.name: Michael G. Scott
basics.label: Regional Manager
basics.summary: Regional manager with 15+ years in mid-range paper sales. I lead with heart first and spreadsheets second: my branch runs on trust, improv rules, and the occasional conference-room meeting that could have been an email. I believe a team that laughs together outsells a team that doesn't.

work.name: Dunder Mifflin Paper Company
work.summary: Rehired after the Michael Scott Paper Company buyout. Run the most resilient branch of the company.
highlights: Kept Scranton the top-performing branch through two mergers and one very long recession.
Retained 100% of key accounts during the Michael Scott Paper Company transition, including Lackawanna County.
Mentored future managers through a highly personalized, largely unscripted leadership style.

work.name: Michael Scott Paper Company
work.summary: Independent paper startup founded in a converted office closet.
highlights: Won back major clients in one quarter through aggressive personal service and below-cost pricing.
Negotiated the company's acquisition by Dunder Mifflin, securing positions for all employees.

work.name: Dunder Mifflin Paper Company
highlights: Promoted from sales to regional management after consecutive top-salesman years.
Hosted the annual Dundie Awards, the branch's longest-running recognition program.

work.name: Dunder Mifflin Paper Company
highlights: Built a client book that still anchors the branch's revenue.

projects.name: Threat Level Midnight
projects.description: Written, directed and starred in an independent action feature over eleven years of meticulous principal photography.
highlights: Completed post-production despite budget, studio notes and hockey schedules.

projects.name: Michael Scott's Dunder Mifflin Scranton Meredith Palmer Memorial Celebrity Rabies Awareness Pro-Am Fun Run Race For The Cure
projects.description: Founded and hosted a charity 5K raising rabies awareness across the greater Scranton area.
highlights: Secured full office participation and a generous check presentation ceremony.
